plusserver.summary_note: plusserver is one of Germany's strongest sovereignty-focused cloud providers and occupies a unique position as a founding contributor to the Sovereign Cloud Stack (SCS) open-source project and GAIA-X. Its pluscloud open tier (SCS/OpenStack) is genuinely sovereign: German-owned infrastructure, BSI C5 Type II attested, GDPR-compliant, open-source, SCS-interoperable, and 100% renewable energy powered. Key strengths: BSI C5 Type II + ISO 27001 + PCI-DSS v4.0 certification portfolio, GAIA-X founding membership, SCS open-source leadership, exclusively German data centres, and a ~400-person German engineering team. The main weakness is the dual-product portfolio: pluscloud VMware introduces a critical dependency on Broadcom (US), which cannot be operated independently if US vendor support is withdrawn, and which is closed-source proprietary software. For full sovereignty, customers should use pluscloud open exclusively. The private equity ownership (BC Partners, seeking sale in 2024) introduces some change-of-control uncertainty that differentiates plusserver from structurally independent providers like STACKIT or Infomaniak. Supply chain hardware (Intel/AMD/NVIDIA) limitations are universal across the industry.
